response.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country, '') AS death_country, p.player_id, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / NULLIF(v.points_max, 0)) AS player_average FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(p.death_country, ''), p.player_id), country_averages AS (SELECT death_country, AVG(player_average) AS country_average FROM player_averages WHERE player_average IS NOT NULL GROUP BY death_country) SELECT death_country, country_average, country_average / AVG(country_average) OVER () AS relative_to_mean_country_average FROM country_averages;
